Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://www.hillagric.ac.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.

Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Chaudhary Sarwan Kumar Himachal Pradesh Krishi Vishvavidyalaya (CSKHPKV), Palampur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Young Professional-II under project-based employment.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Young Professional-II post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Plant Breeding/ Genetics / Plant Pathology / Biotechnology / Life Sciences along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of offline applications is 21-10-2026.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through offline mode by filling out the prescribed proforma and sending it via post along with required documents and application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General category candidates is Rs. 450/- paid via bank draft.

faq.question: Q9. When will the work specific interaction take place?
faq.answer: The work specific interaction is scheduled to be held on 23-10-2026 at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Completed applications should be sent to the Head, Department of Genetics & Plant Breeding, CSKHPKV, Palampur.
